frequency_question: How often do proposed Section 123 agreements successfully face a joint resolution of disapproval passed over a veto or unvetoed within the statutory review period?
membership_rule: Members are formal 123 agreements submitted for congressional review. Excluded are informal discussions, civil nuclear deals not requiring formal congressional submission, or non-nuclear trade pacts.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major contested historical submissions examined out of roughly 25-30 total routine or contested 123 agreements.
known_gaps: Routine agreements that breeze through without formal congressional contestation are omitted from the contested subset, but including them only drives the success rate of blocking even closer to zero.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreement review cycles historically resulting in a successful blocking joint resolution overcoming presidential dynamics.
multiplier: 0 successful joint resolutions out of dozens of submitted 123 agreements.
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks under the Atomic Energy Act and legislative review procedures for nuclear pacts remain stable across decades.
